duties.title: Early Game
duties.description: As a settler, your primary focus in the early game will be to join your Homeguard in establishing outposts and securing Clash Points. As you gain influence over the Island, you will gain access to Mana Crystals which can be used to expand your influence.

duties.title: Mid Game
duties.description: As the game progresses, it is your duty to ensure the safety of your allies and the expansion of your faction's influence. This will involve working with your allies to defend Clash Points from opposing factions and occasionally launching attacks to take control of new points.

duties.title: Late Game
duties.description: Once you have established control over the Island, it is time to push the advantage and secure victory for your faction. Keep up the momentum by summoning additional Clash units and press the assult on your enemies.
